items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment. Reject new spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, and unsupported revenue claims. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The $4.92 aggregate row is not site-attributable; site-attributed commission is $0, which does not prove zero site performance. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and cost windows do not align; AI-cost records conflict ($881.36 across 4,832 calls for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27 versus retained $973.35 across 5,439 calls); infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, and approved-budget records are absent or incomplete; and experiments lack defined incremental costs and learning outcomes. The 2026-09-27 30-day scorecard reports 47 failure follow-ups open, 28 deployed improvements awaiting measurement, and only 2 proven outcomes. Retain the three SEO/performance opportunities as deferred prioritization evidence only. Continue the existing period-aligned attribution and cost reconciliation; minimum measurement is aligned revenue, site/content attribution, AI, infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, approved-budget, and defined learning-outcome records. Do not treat impressions, rankings, clicks, sessions, conversions, performance scores, ordered items, or AI usage as financial returns.

Retain the three cited SEO/performance opportunities as deferred backlog only. Their impressions, positions, CTR targets, and mobile performance signals support prioritization, not revenue, contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, or causal-lift claims. Continue existing repair-or-close and reconciliation work before reconsidering implementation.
